title: CanonicalPreInterest
description: Public, write-only pre-interest registration contracts for the Canonical quote platform.

PreInterestRegistrationRequest.description: Enumeration-resistant public registration request. Identity, source host, network metadata, and idempotency are derived or accepted separately by the server.

requestVersion.description: Public registration contract version; only version 1 is accepted.

registrationKind.description: Whether the prospect is registering as an individual or for an organization.

contactEmail.description: Business contact email normalized by the server. A receipt never reveals whether it was already registered.

organizationName.description: Organization name; required for organization registrations.

organizationDomain.description: Optional lower-case DNS domain normalized and strictly validated by the server; no scheme, port, path, or credentials.

role.description: Optional role or team for follow-up context.

interestAreas.description: Bounded products or programs the prospect wants to discuss.

notes.description: Optional bounded context. Secrets, credentials, regulated records, and customer datasets must not be submitted.

privacyVersion.description: Versioned privacy notice acknowledged by the registrant.

contactConsent.description: Explicit consent to receive follow-up about the selected interests.

sourcePath.description: Optional same-site path attribution. The source host is always derived from the accepted request host.

PreInterestRegistrationReceipt.description: Uniform accepted receipt returned for both new and idempotently repeated registrations.

registrationId.description: Opaque registration receipt identifier; it is not an authorization credential.

status.description: Uniform public status that does not reveal prior registration state.

nextStep.description: Type-safe next action. The browser maps it to a reviewed same-site route instead of following a server-supplied URL.

message.description: Safe public confirmation text with no account or duplication disclosure.
